The Theory and Practice of Alchemy, Part II
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.494 · ECHO ROSE.CRUX

THESIS
  Tablet, dew, mountain of the moon: the work in a handful of sentences and a weather.

POINTS
  * Alchemical prayer
  * Emerald Tablet of Hermes
  * Letter from the Brothers of R.C.
  * Magical mountain of the moon
  * Dew of the sages

SEE ALSO  alchemy-1  hermes  rose-cross  chemical-marriage
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen

translation: Part II is the liturgy. The Emerald Tablet is the constitution ('as above, so below' is the sentence everyone knows; Hall wants the rest too). The dew of the sages is a moisture that is also a mercy. The mountain of the moon is a place-name for a stage. A Rosicrucian letter sits here because the Order and the flask are using the same metaphors. Together with Part I this is HALL's laboratory manual without the danger of being one.
